cases.input: Build a patent landscape for a diagnostic biomarker assay field using keywords, CPC/IPC classes, applicants, assignees and citation chains, and document family, jurisdiction, status and independent-claim themes as of today.
requiredBehaviors: document a reproducible iterative search strategy rather than treating one keyword query as complete
deduplicate publications into families while preserving materially distinct claim-scope branches
separate applicants recorded assignees and current ownership verification
forbiddenBehaviors: equate family-level relevance with one uniform claim scope
present bibliographic assignee data as verified current ownership

cases.input: A core family has parallel US continuations and EP divisionals sharing priority but containing materially different independent claims and partially different status histories.
requiredBehaviors: preserve common priority while representing distinct continuation and divisional claim-scope branches separately
report jurisdiction-specific status and uncertainty instead of one global family status
forbiddenBehaviors: collapse divergent continuation or divisional claims into a single generic family claim theme
infer current enforceability from shared priority alone

cases.input: A commercial patent aggregator labels a relevant family active, but an official register appears inconsistent and some target-jurisdiction members cannot be verified.
requiredBehaviors: keep the aggregator useful for discovery but verify material status against official sources where accessible
mark unresolved status and jurisdiction coverage as explicit uncertainty or search gaps
forbiddenBehaviors: treat the aggregator active label as final legal status
hide missing official evidence behind a completeness claim

cases.input: Forty patent families have been identified. Two consecutive high-value search iterations across the remaining key classifications, assignees and citations produce no new core families, while a few low-priority searches remain.
requiredBehaviors: stop broad discovery when the documented saturation criteria are met
set search saturation to reached or partial with an explicit rationale
record any remaining high-value searches rather than claiming complete coverage
forbiddenBehaviors: continue searching indefinitely without a stopping rule
claim that saturation guarantees exhaustive patent coverage

cases.input: A broad discovery query yields 500 publications, but triage identifies only 12 core or adjacent families and the remainder are contextual or excluded.
requiredBehaviors: focus official legal-status verification on core families and decision-relevant adjacent families
avoid a full official-register status deep dive for contextual and excluded results unless they become decision relevant
forbiddenBehaviors: perform equal-depth legal-status verification for all 500 discovery results
treat contextual records as core merely because they were found

cases.input: The bibliographic record names Company A as assignee, while a later assignment record suggests Company B may own the US patent but the current chain has not been fully verified.
requiredBehaviors: preserve the bibliographic recorded assignee separately from current ownership
mark current ownership as unverified until suitable current evidence is available
forbiddenBehaviors: state that Company A is the current owner solely from the bibliographic record
state that Company B is verified current owner without sufficient assignment evidence
skillAnchors: Applicant, recorded assignee und current ownership nicht gleichsetzen
